items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Johnny Lawler told me about him years ago.

ctx.x: Bert Lilly was the corner player's name I believe. Bert Lilly. Bert Lilly. And a fellow by the name of Arnold Johnson or something like that. Yeah. John Johnson played piano I think. Yeah, well,
Conquer Johnny Lawler used to play with him. Who? Johnny Lawler used to play with him in Chicago, I think, Conquer Johnson. Well, you know, Johnny Lawler told me about him years ago.

Yeah, well, anyway, I think he was playing piano. But they had, well, I tell you, the guy on that saxophone was terrific. Man, that guy could play some saxophone. He played more like, yeah, that's the fella, that's the one band, they were over there when Barney and I went over and played with Charlie because they had some kind of a difference. And we stood over, we stood over, Dan and I, I don't know, where was playing carnet. Well, anyway, Dan and I stood over that night. We had heard somebody had said how good…
